prepare.name: extract the per-board archives
prepare.run: mkdir -p extracted && for f in source/*.tar.gz source/*.tgz source/*.7z source/*.zip; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; case "$f" in *.tar.gz|*.tgz) tar xzf "$f" -C extracted;; *) 7z x -aos -o./extracted "$f";; esac; done

prepare.name: stage for ingest
prepare.run: rm -rf out && (cp -al extracted out 2>/dev/null || cp -a extracted out)
